# ND-5000

ND-5000 micro program, 128-bit word, control store 16K

- **Name for `%#MODEL` and the settings:** `nd5000`
- **Also accepted:** `nd-5000`
- **Word width in the bit view:** 128 bits
- **Image written by *Assemble*:** 16 bytes per word, 262144 bytes
- **Ending of the image file:** `.DATA`
- **Mnemonics:** 609
- **Colours shared with:** ND-500 and ND-5000
- **Definitions:** [`defs/tokens/nd5000-tokens.yaml`](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/nd-microcode-meta/blob/main/defs/tokens/nd5000-tokens.yaml)

## How the bits are given

The word is 8 groups of 16 bits. Each group is written as 6 octal digits, most significant group first. Groups that are all zero are left out of the tables below. A mnemonic sets the bits that are 1 in its groups; the mnemonics of one instruction are ORed together.

## Fields of the word

`control_store_words` in the definitions: 16384.

| Field | Bits | Description |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| `ALU_TRUE` | 127:122 | ALU function, true path (4-bit op + 2-bit carry) |
| `ALU_FALSE` | 121:116 | ALU function, false path (4-bit op + 2-bit carry) |
| `EXUC` | 115 | execute unconditional |
| `COND_ALU` | 114 | enable conditional ALU operation |
| `Q_REG` | 113:111 | Q register operation |
| `AAP_CTRL` | 110:103 | AAP control (3-bit selector + 5-bit op) |
| `TIMING` | 102:101 | cycle time (JSON field is named TIMING, not CYCLE) |
| `DATATYPE` | 100:98 | data type |
| `OR_ENABLE` | 97 | OR control enable (gates ORCON) |
| `A_OP` | 96:89 | A operand select (3-bit group + 5-bit register) |
| `B_OP` | 88:84 | B operand select |
| `DEST` | 83:76 | destination select (default 24 = D,NOOP) |
| `STATUS` | 75:72 | status operation |
| `IXC_INCR` | 71 | index counter increment (IXADJ) |
| `LC_DECR` | 70 | loop counter decrement (LCDECR) |
| `COND_SEQ` | 69 | enable conditional sequence |
| `SEQ_TRUE` | 68:65 | sequencer, true path (2-bit jump + 2-bit stack) |
| `SEQ_FALSE` | 64:61 | sequencer, false path (2-bit jump + 2-bit stack) |
| `INVSEQ` | 60 | invert test condition |
| `CSAVE` | 59 | push test condition to stack |
| `TESTOBJ` | 58:53 | test object (condition select) |
| `ABR` | 52:51 | alternative branch address calculation |
| `TBC` | 50:48 | instruction cache write control (default 7 = TBC,NOOP) |
| `GET` | 47:44 | instruction/operand fetch |
| `STOP` | 43 | stop microprogram |
| `AAPSYNC` | 42 | wait for AAP ready |
| `MEM_BIT3` | 41 | memory op code bit 3 (see class remarks) |
| `AD_ARTI` | 40 | address arithmetic (extracted but never emitted by the JS) |
| `EA_SAVE` | 39:38 | effective address save (lives in the MEMORY group of the JSON) |
| `MEMOT` | 37 | memory request if data operand (C,MEMOT) |
| `RESERVED_36` | 36 | reserved - not in the JS FIELDS table |
| `ADACT` | 35 | address arithmetic activate |
| `MEM_BITS20` | 34:32 | memory op code bits 2-0 (see class remarks) |
| `ABS_ADDR` | 31:16 | sequencer jump target address |
| `AA` | 15:13 | address A operand select |
| `AB` | 12:9 | address B operand select |
| `SCAL` | 8:6 | index scaling |
| `ORCON` | 5:0 | OR control (only meaningful when OR\_ENABLE set) |

### Sub-fields

Parts of the fields above that the assembler fills separately.

| Sub-field | Bits | Description |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| `ALU_OP` | 127:124 | ALU\_TRUE op - JS decodeAlu: (v &gt;&gt; 2) &amp; 0xF |
| `ALU_CRY` | 123:122 | ALU\_TRUE carry - JS decodeAlu: v &amp; 3 |
| `ALUF_OP` | 121:118 | ALU\_FALSE op |
| `ALUF_CRY` | 117:116 | ALU\_FALSE carry |
| `SEQT_TYPE` | 68:67 | SEQ\_TRUE jump - JS decodeSeq: (v &gt;&gt; 2) &amp; 3 |
| `SEQT_STACK` | 66:65 | SEQ\_TRUE stack - JS decodeSeq: v &amp; 3 |
| `SEQF_TYPE` | 64:63 | SEQ\_FALSE jump |
| `SEQF_STACK` | 62:61 | SEQ\_FALSE stack |
| `ORCON_N` | 5 | OR control: next |
| `ORCON_E` | 4 | OR control: enable |
| `ORCON_A` | 3:2 | OR control: address |
| `ORCON_D` | 1:0 | OR control: data |
